sheets.name: run_1
sheets.action: running (his move loop): his flaming hands swinging, the flames on his head flickering, the LEGS CHANGING OVER (6 frames)
sheets.weapons: HIS HANDS go where the pale figure has them, frame by frame (image 3 shows them in colour): both hands ON FIRE as in image 1 (the flames are part of him, shaped as in the old frame), held low, thrust forward, spread wide or brought down as the pale figure holds them; the flames on his head as in image 1, flickering as the old frame's. The pale figures of his attack, W (skill) and E then Q (skill2) are the old frames' bodies without their casting flashes: do NOT draw those flashes. Only him: no fireballs, no pillars of flame, no flying sparks, no glow around him.
sheets.legs: Frame 1: STRIDE: the NEAR leg (the lighter one) reaching forward (image right) to land, its heel coming down; the FAR leg (the darker one) behind (image left) pushing off, its toes on the ground. Frame 2: SUPPORT ON THE NEAR LEG: the near leg planted straight down under his hips; the FAR leg kicked up and back behind him, bent, its foot off the ground. The two legs TAKE TURNS: in frames 1-3 the NEAR leg (the lighter one) carries him, in frames 4-6 the FAR leg (the darker one) - frames 2 and 5 must look different: a different leg planted, the other one kicked back. Never the same leg in front in every frame (Senna's first run did that, and Talon's: 「走路没有换腿」).
